_readme: Knowledge scopes recognized by the RAG system (PLAN 10, ADR-0011). This is THE global place to add or remove a recognized scope/tag. To recognize a new integration platform: add an entry below, then label the matching Confluence pages with that exact 'name' (case-insensitive — Confluence lowercases labels) — nothing else in the codebase needs to change. 'obi-general-test' is the always-included base scope and must always be present (the app fails fast at startup otherwise); it is the scope untagged content falls into and is always allowed at retrieval.

scopes.name: obi-general-test
scopes.description: Base scope: content that applies to all customers/platforms. Always present, always allowed, never inferred from an untagged chunk (ADR-0011 Decision 1).

scopes.name: obi-toast-test
scopes.description: Toast POS integration content. Third-party platform — not this repo's own codename (see ADR-0011).
